notes.subject: sɔrɔya
notes.rationale: אוקיר read as 'make rare/scarce' (KJV margin, YLT) versus 'make precious/valuable' (Geneva) — scarcity fits the destruction context

notes.subject: comparison
notes.rationale: human worth weighed against fine gold and Ophir gold — a measuring of rarity

notes.subject: אנוש / אדם
notes.rationale: two words for 'mortal man' paired, as מפז and מכתם pair two golds

translation: Ne bɛna hadamaden kɛ sɔrɔya ye sanu finman ye, hadamaden ka kɛ sɔrɔya ye Ophir (Opir) ka sanu ye.
